Match flow, left to right. Host picks from Явь, guest from Навь — the two sides never share a faction pool.

No heroes: recruitment is the whole pre-battle game.

15×11 hexes, HoMM3's board. Unreachable hexes sink into the dark rather than lighting up what you CAN reach — with a speed-8 stack that would be 122 of 165 cells, i.e. noise.

The red panel is the point: outcome before you commit.
